# time.now

> > A comprehensive global time and information platform providing real-time current times, timezones, prayer times, weather, and astronomical data for cities and regions worldwide.

time.now is a multi-purpose world information hub that combines precise timekeeping with location-based data. The platform serves users seeking current local times across 200+ locations, timezone conversions, Islamic prayer schedules, weather conditions, air quality monitoring, and astronomical events.

## Key Topics

- Current Time
- Time Zones
- World Clock
- UTC/GMT
- Timezone Converter
- Global Cities
- IANA Timezones
- Prayer Times
- Local Times
- Major Cities
- Atomic Time
- Sunrise/Sunset
- Islamic Calendar
- Weather
- Air Quality Index

## Core Time Tools

- [Current Time Now](https://time.now): Homepage showcasing current time across major cities and global timezones
- [Online Clock](https://time.now/clock): Precise online clock with full-screen mode and atomic time synchronization
- [Interactive Time Zone Map](https://time.now/time-zone-map): Interactive world map for exploring timezones and city search

## Global Location Browsing

- [Current Time in All Countries](https://time.now/countries): Complete list of all countries with live current local times
- [Current Local Time in Most Popular Cities](https://time.now/cities): Live current times for most popular cities worldwide
- [World Time by Continent](https://time.now/continents): Browse current time across all seven continents and major cities
- [Current Time in States & Regions Worldwide](https://time.now/regions): Browse current time in states and regions across 200+ locations

## Timezone Reference

- [Time Now in All Time Zones](https://time.now/timezones): Reference guide for all major timezones (EST, PST, UTC, GMT, CET)
- [All IANA Timezones Current Times](https://time.now/iana-time-zone): Complete IANA/Olson timezone database with live current times

## Astronomical & Natural Data

- [Sunrise Times Today](https://time.now/sunrise): Live sunrise times and countdowns for cities worldwide
- [Sunset Times Today](https://time.now/sunset): Live sunset times and countdowns for cities worldwide
- [Solar & Lunar Eclipses: 2026-2035 Guide & Visibility Schedules](https://time.now/eclipses): Comprehensive eclipse guide with visibility maps and local timings

## Religious & Cultural Information

- [Islamic Prayer Times Worldwide](https://time.now/prayer-times): Accurate daily Islamic prayer times (Salah) for worldwide cities
- [Islamic Calendar 2026](https://time.now/islamic-calendar): Islamic Hijri calendar with prayer times and Ramadan schedule
- [Public Holidays Worldwide](https://time.now/holidays): Global public holidays calendar for next 30 days

## Environmental & Weather Data

- [Weather Around The World](https://time.now/weather): Live weather conditions and temperatures for world capital cities
- [World Air Quality Index (AQI)](https://time.now/aqi): Real-time air quality index monitoring PM2.5 and pollution levels

## Optional

- [Go Premium](https://time.now/premium): Premium subscription plans with ad-free experience and enhanced features
- [Calendar 2026](https://time.now/calendar): Printable calendar with public holidays for worldwide countries
